verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for an open-source framework like Pipecat, so the axis applies. The only version-related evidence is a runtime probe showing a numbered PyPI release (1.8.1). The pack contains no documented API versioning scheme, deprecation policy, changelog commitments or migration guarantees, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
